mutation: load() unlocked + open(path,'r') held 20ms during concurrent locked saves
method: Edited src/server/store.ts load() only; left save/update/switchFile on path lock. Ran server.test.ts name pattern 'two ProjectStore'.

result.test: two ProjectStore instances on one path serialize load and save without EPERM

control.note: Brief unlocked readFile alone often stays 0 under write-locked thrash — Node closes the handle before rename. Holding an open FD is the Windows smoking gun and is what GET/list can do if anything keeps a handle (or any overlapping open). Path lock on load prevents that class.

pathKeys.note: withPathLock keys via path.resolve — relative/absolute/dotdot collapse to one chain. Junctions: resolve does not always canonicalize junctions to the same target; separate ticket if multi-worktree shares one file via junction under different resolved spellings.

reentrancy.switchFile: withPathLock(oldPath) then assigns this.filePath; in-flight RMW pins path at call time via runLocked
